messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-98765 fired: HIGH inference-latency on route /v1/generate (p95 ~1200ms, hosted-us-east-1). Condition: route_latency.p95 > 800ms for 1m. Possible source: sudden KV cache miss/burst.

alex: ack. I'm on it. pulling up traces and dashboards.

incident-bot: PD-98765 acknowledged by alex.

maya: ping — I'm the rotation followup but can help. Any customer-impact reports yet?

alex: no error spikes, just latency. looks like a short burst from tenant "search-prod" — QPS up ~3x for ~90s. KV cache miss rate spiked, lots of cold cache reads. GPUs are hitting mem churn; autoscaler didn't spawn because CPU/memory thresholds stayed low.

sam: thx. if it's cache-miss driven, we can push a fallback routing to a quantized model for that tenant to reduce mem footprint. rolling a small fallback now: route override -> rdx-3b-8q for heavy requests.

alex: trying manual capacity bump while sam routes fallback. running: ```
# add 1 GPU instance to pool
rdxctl capacity adjust --pool inference-us-east-1 --delta +1
kubectl -n inference get pods | grep gpu
```

alex: capacity command accepted, new node requested.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-98766 fired (duplicate noise) — auto-resolve in progress.

maya: I'm seeing the same; metric windows are tiny so alerts are flapping. Can we set short auto-silence for this alert group while we observe? Suggest 10m autosilence to avoid page churn. Runbook says: use PD suppress for noisy transient alerts.

sam: fallback routing is live for ~30s. early telemetry: p95 down to ~250ms for routed traffic.

alex: new node joined — p95 cluster-wide now ~200-300ms. traffic to rdx-3b-8q steady. No customer errors observed.

maya: thanks. I'll mute PD for 10m on PD-98765 to avoid spam. also suggest we tweak the alert to require 3 consecutive 1m windows (current is 1).

alex: agreed. filing a followup ticket to update autoscaler triggers to include GPU mem pressure and to add a brief cooldown. Action: RDX-OPS-1234.

sam: I've started the ticket and added proposed autoscaler patch. Plan: use node GPU memory > 70% sustained 30s -> scale, and require 3m sustained route_latency.p95 > 800ms before paging.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-98765 auto-resolved (no acknowledgment needed).

alex: marking thread resolved — no customer-impact observed (customers served, retries not required). Handing over to maya for overnight watch. Notes: root cause likely KV-cache warmup + tenant reindex traffic. Recommend cache prewarm for heavy tenants and autoscaler metric change.

maya: thanks alex — taking handoff. I'll keep an eye for residual flapping. If it recurs, escalate to eng-runtime.

sam: adding suggested runbook snippets to RDX-OPS-1234 (how to route to quantized fallback, how to adjust PD window).

alex: closing on-call notes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Thread closed at 1777771300.
